text: Ideas, in the order I'd build them: 1) Score-event buying: Novig lags Pinnacle a median 6.6 s after a score-driven move (RESEARCH §116), so buy the stale side only right after a score push, not on price-only moves (those didn't hold). 2) A lower-confidence tier: today the live lane needs 90% sure; I'll paper-record offers at 75-89% to measure the hit rate, then lower the floor on results. 3) Two sharp sources agreeing: Kalshi/SX/Polymarket sockets as a second live fair, buy only when they and Pinnacle agree. 4) Cross-exchange hedges: if Novig on one side and Kalshi/SX on the other pay a profit after fees, take both. The repeat guard already allows this. 5) Live bids: rest orders slightly under fair on stale-prone markets and cancel the moment any socket moves. All are written into TASKS (CH4). Nothing goes live without paper results first. I'll start with #2 since it also answers your low-fills question.
